Pristine official bench.sh/client remain unchanged. v2 addresses Main findings:
1) Original close directly unchanged before supervisor creates shutdown marker.
   Marker created only after idle/APIinflight0 binds actual serverPID/enginePID.
   Only marked shutdown substitutes transparent input observation and records
   original QUIT write/flush, wait exit code and fallback os.kill audit.
2) Inspected actual WC StrataEngine.__init__/restart and Service.ensure_loaded.
   Constructor blocks for actualREADY and sets endedFalse. Bootstrap marks that
   state and prohibits any later constructor/restart/automaticreload through
   explicit BENCH_FATAL + EngineDied, while healthy ensure_loaded uses original
   semantics. Initial lazy restart limited to1; nonlazy starts only1, no retry.
   No invented config flag and no server/benchmark checkout source modification.
3) Health validates exact6completedwordPASSprefix,1..512 mapping segment rows,
   exactuniqueproviderpathset and hashes8debug/7quiet; ordering ignored and
   counts/paths recorded. ASLR mapping order is not a correctness criterion.
4) Existing owned-v0141-measurement.lock acquired before Main config/source/model
   hashes, providers and actual proof reads, retained through final identities.
5) Short descendant pidfd race only accepted after known-parent/start identity
   followed by observed disappearance/terminated pidfd. Status remains unknown
   exit code unless actual direct-parent wait exists. PIDreuse/unlisted owners
   never adopted. Outer-owner session closure remains required by Main.
6) Preserve upstream results.json byte-identically. Record per32K actualgen,
   read/reused/promptcounts and available prompt/decode rates, engine ms, sources.
   Available metrics finitepositive; NaN/Inf/nonpositive invalid. Missing counts
   or metrics completed-but-ineligible; no rate invention/performance recompute.
